name: zmath_vec3_dist_sq_xz
description: zMath::Vec3DistSqXZ stores the X and Z deltas in the shared zMath delta scratch vector and returns the squared XZ-plane distance.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly shows x87 arithmetic and a dead stack scratch slot in the prologue; tier S verification is deferred to a zMath vector-helper source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x472730 validates fastcall ECX=a, EDX=b, writing only g_zMath_Vec3DeltaScratch.x and .z, ignoring Y, and returning dx*dx + dz*dz.
The native zMath smoke verifies the XZ squared distance and that the shared scratch Y slot is preserved.
